name: Nanamori Souji
source:
[i]"We are the Summer Festival Executive Commitee — a secret society working day and night to revive the summer festival."[/i]

Ryuusei's classmate.
Souji has always seen Ryuusei as a rival, because they're the same age.
A stickler for the rules, he values being just and fair above all else.
Although he's always at odds with Ryuusei, he'll still give him praise when it's due.
Coming from a lineage of politicians, he wishes to do everything in his power to contribute to the local community.
The island's declining population is one of his major worries.

[Edited from [url=http://ginka.frontwing.jp/en/characters/?souji]Official English page[/url]]
